blank.label: Blank
blank.description: A navigation bar and one text section

launch.label: Product launch
launch.description: A big headline over the product, logos, features, numbers, quotes, pricing, FAQ and a call to action
launch.layout: nav[role=header] hero[role=section] logos features[role=section #tone-alt] feature[role=section] feature2[role=section #reverse] stats testimonials[role=section #tone-alt] pricing[role=section] faq[role=section] cta[role=section #tone-soft] footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H12@page

company.label: Company
company.description: A headline that switches for each audience, the latest news, what you do, how it works in steps, numbers and a call to action
company.layout: nav[role=header] intro[role=section] news[role=section] feature[role=section #tone-alt] how[role=section] stats[role=section] cta[role=section] footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H8@page

magazine.label: Magazine
magazine.description: A packed front page: a lead story, a grid of stories, a most-read list beside them, a newsletter call and a dark footer
magazine.layout:
nav[role=header] stories[role=main] latest[role=aside] V@body{3:1 maxw=1320} cta[role=section #tone-soft #dense] footer[role=footer #tone-dark #dense] H4@page
rule r1 below=900 flip body

catalogue.label: Catalogue
catalogue.description: A packed shop or service list: a short intro, filters and a grid of cards, questions and a compact footer
catalogue.layout: nav[role=header] intro[role=section #dense] items[role=main] faq[role=section #tone-alt #dense] footer[role=footer #tone-dark #dense] H5@page

portfolio.label: Portfolio
portfolio.description: A headline beside a picture, a gallery of work, who is behind it, quotes and a contact form
portfolio.layout: nav[role=header] hero[role=section] gallery[role=section] about[role=section #tone-alt #reverse] testimonials[role=section] contact[role=section #tone-alt] footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H7@page

article.label: Article
article.description: A blog post or news article with a sidebar
article.layout:
nav[role=header] article[role=main] aside[role=aside] V@body{3:1 maxw=1120} footer[role=footer] H3@page
rule r1 below=900 flip body

docs.label: Documentation
docs.description: A menu on the side and a documentation page
docs.layout:
nav[role=header] menu content[role=main] V@body{1:3 maxw=1120} footer[role=footer] H3@page
rule r1 below=800 flip body

factual.label: Factual
factual.description: An editorial data page: a headline, figures on dark cards, a bar chart beside a highlighted figure, a timeline and a picture banner
factual.layout:
nav[role=header] intro[role=section] figures[role=section] chart[role=main] highlight[role=aside] V@pulse{3:2 maxw=1280} timeline[role=section #tone-alt] banner[role=section] footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H7@page
rule r1 below=900 flip pulse

biased.label: Biased
biased.description: A case study told through its decisions: a title with a fact strip, the work in a frame, the story in three parts, decision cards (what was chosen over what, why, what it cost), before and after, the numbers, a quote, credits, the next case and a call to action
biased.layout: nav[role=header] intro[role=section] cover[role=section #tone-alt] story[role=section] decisions[role=section] compare[role=section #tone-alt] results[role=section] quote[role=section #tone-soft] credits[role=section] next[role=section] cta[role=section #tone-alt] footer[role=footer #tone-dark] H12@page
